text: The lookouts are dark blotches on a horizon of sand; vigilant hawks against the horrors of the desert.
A column of gleaming bone holds a stern and ominous watch over the shifting and treacherous Nehekharan sands.
The heat-bleached bone warriors of grim countenance watch over the battlements, watching for foes through hollowed sockets.
These lithified walls have seen empires rise and fall, and endured the accession of doom. They hold.
The hieroglyphics inscribed upon these battlements channel protective wards, fending off any would-be invaders.
Secretive cults invoke the power of Nagash, corrupting the land and summoning the dead.

A great temple devoted to Nagash, its dark rituals spreading corruption far beyond its walls.
The possessions of the dead are gathered to serve their new masters.

A place of forbidden rites where the Winds of Magic are drawn towards the realm of the dead.
Necromantic rituals draw upon the Winds, raising the dead and strengthening Nagash's servants.
A mighty centre of necromantic power where the Winds themselves are bent to the will of the Great Necromancer.
Ancient rites awaken the stone guardians and scorpion constructs of Nehekhara.
Sacred rites bind the spirits of the dead to ever more formidable constructs and Greatbows.
The greatest works of Nehekharan artifice are housed here, including the mighty Khemric Titan.
